children.name: filterable
children.description: When true, the field is exposed in generated CRUD filter allowlists (Project D filter layer).

children.name: sortable
children.description: When true, the field is exposed in generated CRUD sort allowlists. Inherits from @filterable by default; set false to opt out.

children.name: sortableDefaultOrder
children.description: Default sort direction applied when this field is the default sort field.
